option.name: --cli-config-file
tip: Path to a JSON file containing CLI options

option.name: --config
tip: Override a config from .swcrc file

option.name: --config-file
tip: Path to a .swcrc file to use

option.name: --copy-files
tip: When compiling a directory copy over non-compilable files

option.name: --delete-dir-on-start
tip: Whether or not delete output directory on start

option.name: --env-name
tip: The name of the 'env' to use when loading configs and plugins

option.name: --extensions
tip: Use specific extensions

option.name: --filename
tip: Filename to use when reading from stdin

option.name: --help
tip: Display help for command

option.name: --ignore
tip: List of glob paths to **not** compile

option.name: --include-dotfiles
tip: Include dotfiles when compiling and copying non-compilable files

option.name: --log-watch-compilation
tip: Log a message when a watched file is successfully compiled

option.name: --no-swcrc
tip: Whether or not to look up .swcrc files

option.name: --only
tip: List of glob paths to **only** compile

option.name: --out-dir
tip: Compile an input directory of modules into an output directory

option.name: --out-file
tip: Compile all input files into a single file

option.name: --out-file-extension
tip: Use a specific extension for the output files

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress compilation output

option.name: --source-file-name
tip: Set `sources[0]` on returned source map

option.name: --source-map-target
tip: Set `file` on returned source map

option.name: --source-maps
tip: Generate source maps

next.name: both
tip: Both inline and external source maps

next.name: false
tip: Disable source maps

next.name: inline
tip: Inline source maps as data URLs

next.name: true
tip: Generate external source maps

option.name: --source-root
tip: The root from which all sources are relative

option.name: --strip-leading-paths
tip: Remove the leading directory when building the final output path

option.name: --sync
tip: Invoke swc synchronously

option.name: --version
tip: Output the version number

option.name: --watch
tip: Recompile files on changes

option.name: --workers
tip: The number of workers to use for parallel processing
